summary: Cas Russell, a private investigator, reacts to a phone call from Rio, who is working undercover and declines help, leaving Cas to feel hurt and uneasy about his motives. Cas then calls Anton, an information broker at Mack's Garage, to research the word "Pithica" possibly linked to Colombian drug runners. Cas and Courtney then drive through Los Angeles traffic on the 405 freeway, and Cas asks Courtney about her cash situation.
one_line: Cas Russell hangs up on Rio, hires information broker Anton to research "Pithica," and drives Courtney through Los Angeles traffic.
key_facts: Rio was still undercover, which Cas had not expected given that Rio's usual method was to go in, hurt the people who needed hurting, and get out.
Rio ended the call with the words "God be with you" and hung up without giving a time or place.
Cas notes that a nice explosion would have left only a crater and the bodies of several eviscerated drug dealers if taking down the gang had been Rio's only objective.
Rio had referred Dawna to Cas to get Courtney out, rather than doing it himself, which Cas finds puzzling.
Cas thinks Rio was working his own angle and did not want help, even from her.
Cas calls Anton at Mack's Garage, an information broker she has hired over the past couple of years.
Cas asks Anton to find everything he can on the word "Pithica," which may have ties to Colombian drug runners.
Anton says he needs two hours to get the information.
Cas and Courtney are stuck in rush hour traffic on the 405 freeway in Southern California.
The temperature rose by a full thirty-four degrees Fahrenheit with the rising sun as they headed into Los Angeles.
Cas asks Courtney whether she has cash or whether her money is all in the bank.
The car they are driving is described as a junkpot car.
